req.title: Cookie name path segment escaping
req.statement: The system shall percent-decode the <name> and <value> path segments in /cookies/set/<name>/<value>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /cookies/set/<name>/<value> must percent-decode the name and value path segments. Flask/Werkzeug automatically percent-decodes path segments before passing them to the route handler, so the set_cookie handler receives already-decoded strings. Tests must verify: (1) normal ASCII name/value sets cookie correctly (EP positive), (2) percent-encoded special characters in name/value are decoded and set correctly (EP positive with encoding), (3) percent-encoded space (%20) in name and value is decoded to a literal space (BVA), (4) a name with percent-encoded equals sign is decoded (BVA), (5) empty-string-equivalent or single-char boundary names (BVA), (6) invalid/malformed percent sequences handled gracefully (NEG). All tests use in-process Flask test_client with follow_redirects=True to reach /cookies and inspect the JSON payload, asserting exact cookie name and value strings to catch mutations that skip decoding, swap name/value, or alter the cookie key.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_plain_ascii_name_and_value
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No prior cookies set on client
expected: No other unexpected cookies in response
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: plain ASCII name/value path segments are passed through as-is
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_plain_ascii_name_and_value():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/mycookie/myvalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['mycookie'] == 'myvalue'

test_set_cookie_plain_ascii_name_and_value()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_name_and_value_not_swapped
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify cookie key is 'alpha' and value is 'beta', not reversed
expected: 'beta' is NOT a key in cookies
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: name segment maps to cookie key, value segment maps to cookie value; DT covers name/value assignment correctness
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_name_and_value_not_swapped():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/alpha/beta', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'alpha' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['alpha'] == 'beta'
    assert 'beta' not in data['cookies']

tests.name: test_set_cookie_redirect_location_points_to_cookies_endpoint
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Inspect Location header of redirect response
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: state transition from set_cookie -> view_cookies via redirect; STC verifies redirect target and cookie header
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_redirect_location_points_to_cookies_endpoint():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/sid/abc123', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location.endswith('/cookies'), f"Location was: {location}"
    set_cookie_header = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'sid' in set_cookie_header
    assert 'abc123' in set_cookie_header

test_set_cookie_redirect_location_points_to_cookies_endpoint()
